title: Charges, attunement and identification when loot is awarded
summary: The DM can now set an item's uses, attunement requirement and unidentified name as the item is awarded or added, instead of editing it afterwards.
items: Add loot, an encounter's loot review and an NPC's inventory each have Charges, attunement & identification, with the same limits as editing an item.
The item is created with these details in one step, and pressing again after a dropped connection never adds it twice.
Players see an item awarded unidentified only by the name, description and value the DM gave it, everywhere it appears.
Items added without these details work exactly as before.
